svg.aria-label: Two failure modes behind falling clicks, told apart by position. Failure mode 1: position and impressions up, clicks flat or down, the AI Overview signature. The fix is GEO and CTR work: FAQ schema, quotable definitions, structured data, and title and meta rewrites. Failure mode 2: position and clicks both down, a quality or authority problem. The fix is content quality, internal links, redirect cleanup and backlinks. Most SEO recovery advice only covers failure mode 2.
